_comment: DIP (untrained U-Net) FPM reconstruction of 32a (parallel-beam objective-FZP scan, 30 keV, dr = 250 nm, kc = 2.00 um^-1): rings 0-2 bright + rings 6-7 dark field (155 images); crop 512 px; 30 iterations (final state used)

dip._shift_mode_options: image: per-image lateral image shift (units: camera pixels; e.g. sample/optics drift); illumination: per-image illumination wave-vector correction (units: crop spectrum pixel dk). Both bounded by shift_max via tanh.
dip._select_comment: selected iteration = earliest evaluation with validation band misfit <= (1 + select_tol) x minimum
dip._mask_comment: mask_vignetted: FOV model excludes pixels where the model direct beam leaves the pupil (needed for large crops); off here to keep the 512-crop results as reported
dip._dark_comment: dark_mode: images with |k| > pupil_radius kc (rings 6-7) are dark field on the common bright-level scale (d32a/prep_32a_df.py), masks dfmask.npy, noise weights from noise.json

_comment_registration: input = d32a/work_df_nd: bright part registered like the BF set (rounding + pairwise network + model refinement); dark part (rings 6-7) with the rounding correction only (the pairwise dark-field correction did not change the held-out misfit)
_comment_posaffine: input: d32a/work_df_aff2 = bright part from fpt_output_32a_bf_aff2/work; dark images (rings 6-7) corrected by the linear mechanical drift B_mech of the posaffine step (extrapolated)
_comment_aff2: aff2 (2026-09-28): posaffine with the focus loop (residual object defocus moved into the pupil, retained parallax updated)
_comment_half: split-half FRC data set A, seed 0 (different seeds for A and B), d32a/frc/setup_halves.py
